fusions.name: Raked Together
fusions.desc: Drags the tines across the target, dealing 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Clean Sweep
fusions.desc: Sweeps a wide cone 4 tiles long, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Buried Tines
fusions.desc: Sets a trap at the nearest enemy that waits up to 40 seconds. The first 2 enemies to come within 2 tiles take 18 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Firmly Gathered
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 14% more damage.
